mapper.select: select cr.id, cr.name, cr.is_active, cr.primary_admin_id, cr.secondary_admin_id, c.name AS courseName, c.is_in_progress AS courseIsInProgress, c.start_date, c.end_date, u_pri.id AS priUserId, u_pri.fullname AS priUserFullname, u_sec.id AS secUserId, u_sec.fullname AS secUserFullname from classroom cr join classroom_allocation ca on cr.id = ca.classroom_id join course c on c.id = ca.course_id and c.is_in_progress = 1 JOIN user u_pri ON cr.primary_admin_id = u_pri.id JOIN user u_sec ON cr.secondary_admin_id = u_sec.id union select cr.id, cr.name, cr.is_active, cr.primary_admin_id, cr.secondary_admin_id, c.name AS courseName, c.is_in_progress AS courseIsInProgress, c.start_date, c.end_date, u_pri.id AS priUserId, u_pri.fullname AS priUserFullname, u_sec.id AS secUserId, u_sec.fullname AS secUserFullname from classroom cr left join classroom_allocation ca on cr.id = ca.classroom_id left join course c on c.id = ca.course_id LEFT JOIN user u_pri ON cr.primary_admin_id = u_pri.id LEFT JOIN user u_sec ON cr.secondary_admin_id = u_sec.id where cr.id not in (select cr.id from classroom cr join classroom_allocation ca on cr.id = ca.classroom_id join course c on c.id = ca.course_id and c.is_in_progress = 1) order by name asc
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM classroom WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user WHERE id = #{base.loginUserId} AND type = 'ADMINISTRATOR') AND id = #{classroom.id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classroom (name, primary_admin_id, secondary_admin_id) VALUES (#{classroom.name}, #{classroom.primaryAdminId}, #{classroom.secondaryAdminId});
mapper.select: SELECT crm.name AS classroom_name, crs.name AS course_name, crs.start_date AS start_date, crs.end_date AS end_date FROM classroom crm LEFT JOIN classroom_allocation ca ON crm.id = ca.classroom_id LEFT JOIN course crs ON ca.course_id = crs.id WHERE crs.start_date IS NULL OR crs.start_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 9 MONTH) ORDER BY crm.name, crs.start_date
